evidence.reason: The parser declares phase-specific inputs such as --boundary and --record optional, and main dispatches on the phase without validating required combinations. For matrix boundary/observe phases this lets dispatch reach MATRIX_CASES with a missing boundary (KeyError) or with a different valid boundary (wrong retained case); recovery phases can similarly receive missing required inputs. Rejecting these before dispatch, or deriving the matrix case from the phase name, is a routine correctness fix rather than a new requirement.
